rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to express a deadline or ‘not later than’ a specified time.

example.english: You need to be home by six.
example.traditional: 你要喺六點之前返到屋企。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 hai2 luk6 dim2 zi1 cin4 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this for something located next to or beside A.

example.english: The café is by the MTR station.
example.traditional: 間咖啡店喺地鐵站隔籬。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3 hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 gaak3 lei4

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that an action is done using N as the means.

example.english: I take photos by using a camera.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 soeng2 gei1 jing2 soeng2

rows.note: Use this formal passive construction to identify A as the agent, including the creator of a work.

example.english: This work was created by a local artist.
example.traditional: 呢幅作品由本地藝術家創作。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 zok3 ban2 jau4 bun2 dei6 ngai6 seot6 gaa1 cong3 zok3
